description:
Resolve the final documentation review findings concerning durability guarantees, event-log claims, addressable-item grammar, graph direction, and stale dogfooding narration.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Atomic-write, event-log, Git-requirement, and invariant documentation states only source-backed guarantees without rotting enumerations or causal-order claims.
- [hard] REQ-02: Item-address grammar, dependency data examples, graph root/leaf guidance, and jq snippets match the current data model and CLI behavior.
- [hard] REQ-03: Dogfooding examples are timeless or clearly historical, with no current-state claims that can rot.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scoped mechanical documentation checks and repository validation pass.
title: Correct core guarantees, item grammar, and graph documentation semantics
